description: Docked Bikeshare Ridership By System, Year, Month, and Hour is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Bicycles and Pedestrians", published or maintained by Bureau of Transportation Statistics. Data from 2019 through 2023. For years after 2023, see: Historic data updated on 07/14/2023. Q4 of 2023 and data for all years on systems allowing parking outside of a docking station updated on 06/04/2024. Bikeshare ridership by system, year, month, and hour the trip ended at for bikeshare systems with docking stations. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Bicycles and Pedestrians". It has 9 columns, among them hour, num_trip, sysname, sysid, sysname_alt, assigned_month. The portal shows 2024-07-22 as the last data update. Attribution given: Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
